name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2026-06-25, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
